transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1420 Birch Vale Drive?
Yes, this is 1420 Birch Vale Drive. We have four people here. No water inside. We can help with a boat.
Thank you for confirming your address and readiness to assist. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people are here. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know everyone is reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or oxygen needed.
Thanks for letting us know everyone can leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone can leave on their own.
Understood, no water inside, everyone can leave on their own. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I don’t have a truck or boat, but I have free seats in my car.
Thanks for sharing your available seats. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet; you can help with 1 free seats. Is that right?
Yes. 4 people. No water inside. I can help with 1 free seat.

Thank you for confirming and offering assistance. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
